title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
3、乘秋千旅行的猫
chéng qiū qiān lǚ xíng de māo
page_text_en:
3. The Cat Who Travels on a Swing
chéng qiū qiān lǚ xíng de māo
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的章节标题页，显示第3章标题为《乘秋千旅行的猫》。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
从前, 有一只猫, 是一只黑黑的猫。
黑猫不是神猫, 也不是那种蹲在巫婆脚边、懂一点魔法的猫。
这是一只普普通通的猫, 但他有九个名字。

为什么有九个名字呢? 因为黑猫听老人们说, 猫有九条命。有九条命的猫不该有九个名字吗? 这九个名字分别是——胆大、敢冲、勇猛、冒险、玩命、不怕死、死不了……

我记不全, 反正都是些胆大、不怕死的名字。有九条命的猫还怕什么呢?
page_text_en:
Long ago, there was a cat, a black cat.
The black cat was not a magical cat, nor the kind that crouched by witches' feet, knowing a bit of magic.
This was an ordinary cat, but he had nine names.

Why did he have nine names? Because the black cat heard the old people say that cats have nine lives. Shouldn't a cat with nine lives have nine names? These nine names were—brave, bold, fierce, adventurous, reckless, fearless, and unkillable...

I can't remember them all, but they're all names like brave and fearless. What could a cat with nine lives be afraid of?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事主角——一只普通的黑猫，他有九个名字，分别代表勇敢、冒险等特质，引出‘九条命的猫还怕什么’的疑问，为后续冒险做铺垫。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
话说有那么一天，森林里下了一场暴雨，黑猫想外出走走。他撑起伞走了没多远，天晴了起来，黑猫收起伞，抬头看天。
天空没有一丝云彩，瓦蓝瓦蓝的。

“多么美丽的天空，多么新鲜的空气，真应该飞上蓝天去旅行呢！”
猫是没有翅膀的，黑猫没法飞上天。

黑猫一扭头，看见旁边有棵大树，大树树上挂着一架秋千。黑猫跳上秋千，使劲地荡了起来。
秋千越荡越高，耳边风声呼呼，黑猫得意极了。
page_text_en:
Once upon a time, a heavy rain fell in the forest. The black cat wanted to go out for a walk. He held his umbrella and walked not far when the sky cleared up. The black cat put away his umbrella and looked up at the sky.

The sky had not a single cloud, a deep, clear blue.

"What a beautiful sky, what fresh air—really, I should fly up into the blue sky and travel!"

Cats don’t have wings, so the black cat couldn’t fly up into the sky.

The black cat turned his head and saw a big tree nearby. Hanging from the big tree was a swing. The black cat jumped onto the swing and swung hard.

The swing went higher and higher, the wind whistling in his ears. The black cat felt extremely proud.
summary_zh: 黑猫在雨后晴朗的天空下，因无法飞翔而感到遗憾，于是发现树上的秋千，便跳上去尽情荡漾，享受风中的快乐。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，一只小松鼠说：“黑猫，太危险了，你会从秋千上飞出去的！”
“猫有九条命，死不了的！我正想着乘着秋千飞出去旅行呢……”
此时，秋千已经飞到了高高的天空，黑猫一松手，就从秋千上飞了出去。

黑猫飞过青松林的时候，一棵大青松看见了，大青松说：“太危险了，让我拉你一把！”
page_text_en:
At this moment, a little squirrel said, “Black cat, it’s too dangerous! You’ll fly off the swing!”
“Cats have nine lives, I can’t die! I’m just thinking of flying away on the swing for a trip…”
At this point, the swing had already soared high into the sky, and the black cat let go, flying off the swing.

As the black cat flew over the pine forest, a big pine tree saw him and said, “It’s too dangerous! Let me pull you back!”
summary_zh: 黑猫在秋千上飞得越来越高，小松鼠和大青松都担心他飞出去太危险，纷纷提醒他，但黑猫仍沉浸在飞行的快乐中。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫说："闪开，我是有九条命的猫！"
大青松听了，在黑猫的屁股上使劲拍了一巴掌，黑猫飞得更高更快了。
黑猫飞过白桦林
时，一只大猩猩正在树上看书，他看见一只黑猫从远处飞来，想用书挡住黑猫，救他下来。
黑猫说："别挡我，我是有九条命的猫！"
大猩猩就用书拍了一下黑猫的屁股，黑猫飞得更快更高了。
page_text_en:
The black cat said: "Get out of the way, I'm a cat with nine lives!"
The big green pine tree, upon hearing this, gave the black cat a hard slap on the behind. The black cat flew even higher and faster.
The black cat flew over the birch forest.
At that moment, a big gorilla was reading a book in a tree. He saw a black cat flying in from afar and tried to block him with his book, hoping to save him.
The black cat said: "Don't block me, I'm a cat with nine lives!"
The gorilla then slapped the black cat's behind with his book. The black cat flew even faster and higher.
summary_zh: 黑猫在秋千上越飞越高，大青松和大猩猩先后试图用拍打的方式阻止他，但黑猫自信地宣称自己有九条命，反而飞得更高更快了。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫飞过森林，飞过山峰，飞得越来越高，越来越远，周围连一只鸟都没有了。
黑猫开始害怕了，他不知道自己的九条命在哪儿，眼前他只有一条命，要是摔了下去，他会粉身碎骨，那就一条命也没有了。
黑猫发现自己开始从高空往下面摔，他吓得浑身打战，大声哭叫起来。
黑猫的眼泪飘下天空，落在一个山尖上。山尖上有一只小羚羊正在晒太阳，黑猫的一颗泪珠打在他的鼻尖上。
小羚羊抬头一看，他大声地说：
“怎么又下雨了？还飘过一朵小小的乌云，好奇怪，乌云还拿着一把伞！”
怎么又下雨了！
page_text_en:
The black cat flew over the forest, over the mountain peaks, flying higher and higher, farther and farther, with not even a single bird around.

The black cat began to feel afraid. He didn't know where his nine lives were. Right now, he only had one life. If he fell, he would be shattered to pieces—then he would have no lives left.

The black cat realized he was starting to fall from the high sky. He trembled all over and cried out loudly.

The black cat's tears drifted down from the sky and landed on a mountain peak. On the peak, a little gazelle was sunbathing. A single tear from the black cat landed on his nose.

The gazelle looked up and shouted:

"It's raining again? And there's even a tiny little dark cloud floating by. How strange—this cloud is even holding an umbrella!"

It's raining again!
summary_zh: 黑猫在秋千上飞得太高，开始害怕并从高空坠落，他惊恐地哭叫起来。他的眼泪飘落，被山尖上晒太阳的小羚羊看到，小羚羊误以为下雨了，还注意到乌云拿着伞，感到非常奇怪。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫听见这话，才想起手中还有一把伞，他连忙把伞撑开，伞带着黑猫飘了起来。
小羚羊更惊奇了，他说：“一朵撑伞的乌云！”
伞快撑不住了，黑猫一直往下掉。黑猫吓坏了，大声叫着：“救救我，谁来救救只有一条命的猫……”
幸好，不远处有一座城堡，城堡有个高高尖尖的顶，黑猫拽住城堡的山顶，落了下来。
城堡里，国王、王后和小王子，抬头看见一只黑猫，夹着一把伞从城堡顶上，正小心翼翼地往下爬。
page_text_en:
The black cat heard this and remembered he still had an umbrella in his hand. He quickly opened it, and the umbrella carried the black cat up into the air.
The little gazelle was even more amazed. He said, “A cloud holding an umbrella!”
The umbrella couldn’t hold on any longer, and the black cat fell straight down. The black cat was terrified and screamed, “Help me! Who will save a cat with only one life...”
Luckily, not far away was a castle with a tall, pointed roof. The black cat grabbed onto the castle’s peak and fell down safely.
Inside the castle, the king, queen, and little prince looked up and saw a black cat, holding an umbrella, carefully crawling down from the castle’s roof.
summary_zh: 黑猫从高处坠落时撑开伞自救，被小羚羊误认为是‘撑伞的乌云’，最终落在城堡尖顶上，城堡里的国王、王后和小王子看到他正小心翼翼地往下爬。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
国王大声说：“一只好大胆的猫！”
黑猫被带到国王跟前，国王问他：
“你怎么这么大胆，敢在城堡的尖顶上爬？”

黑猫说：“是活下去的勇气。因为我只有一条命，我不想把命丢了，就得大胆、小心地爬下城堡的顶。”

国王笑了，他说：“你是一只懂得珍惜生命的猫。懂得珍惜生命的人，会好好过自己的一生！”

“对。”黑猫很恭敬地说，“我要好好地过一生！”
page_text_en:
The king shouted, "A very bold cat!"

The black cat was brought before the king, who asked him:
"How dare you be so bold, climbing on the castle's peak?"

The black cat said, "It's the courage to live. Because I only have one life, I don't want to lose it, so I must be bold and careful as I climb down the castle's peak."

The king smiled and said, "You are a cat who understands the value of life. Those who cherish life will live their lives well!"

"Right," the black cat said respectfully, "I want to live my life well!"
summary_zh: 黑猫从城堡尖顶上爬下时被国王发现，国王称赞他大胆，黑猫解释自己珍惜生命，因此才小心谨慎地行动，国王因此肯定他懂得珍惜生命，黑猫也表示要认真过好一生。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
国王很喜欢这只黑猫，就把他留在城堡里，让他当小王子的伙伴和老师。
小王子在黑猫的影响下，懂得了要珍惜自己的生命，还要珍惜王国每一个臣民的生命的道理。
后来，小王子成了一个很好的国王。
黑猫离开森林很久了，开始怀念家乡。
小国王听从黑猫的要求，派了一辆漂亮的马车，把年老的黑猫送回了森林。
这只乘着秋千飞上天的黑猫，是乘着国王的马车重返森林的。
见！
page_text_en:
The king liked this black cat very much, so he kept him in the castle, letting him be the prince's companion and teacher.
Under the black cat's influence, the prince learned to cherish his own life and also to cherish the lives of every subject in the kingdom.
Later, the prince became a very good king.
The black cat had been away from the forest for a long time and began to miss his hometown.
The young king, following the black cat's request, sent a beautiful carriage to return the old black cat to the forest.
This black cat who flew up on a swing is returning to the forest by riding the king's carriage.
See!
summary_zh: 黑猫在城堡中教导小王子珍惜生命，小王子因此成长为一位好国王。黑猫思念家乡，小国王便派马车送他重返森林。

title_en: The Cat Who Traveled on a Swing
page_text_ocr_zh:
重返森林的黑猫，关心和爱护着森林里的每一个伙伴。他让他们懂得珍惜自己的生命，好好过自己的一生的道理。

据说，这只很老很老的黑猫，至今还生活在那座森林里……
page_text_en:
The black cat, returning to the forest, cares for and protects every companion in the woods. He teaches them to cherish their lives and live their lives well.

It is said that this very old, very old black cat still lives in that forest...
summary_zh: 黑猫重返森林，关心和爱护伙伴，教导他们珍惜生命；画面中黑猫坐在摇椅上读报，阳光明媚，森林宁静，暗示他安享晚年。
